aboutParagraphs.text: Active Technical Services (ATS) is an East African engineering, civil-construction, fabrication and industrial-services company based in Jinja, Uganda, with a branch in Dodoma, Tanzania.

introduction.text: For project enquiries and quotation requests, complete the form below or contact Active Technical Services by email or telephone.
introduction.editorial_note: Quote-only enquiry path. No response-time, 24-hour, or WhatsApp claims.

telephoneAlternativeText.editorial_note: Accessible name for the public tel link. The number is not labelled WhatsApp.

emailAlternativeText.editorial_note: Accessible name for the public mailto link.

formUnavailableMessage.text: Online inquiry submission is being prepared. Please contact us by telephone or email.
formUnavailableMessage.editorial_note: Used when the public API origin is missing, the API is asleep, or storage is unavailable. Must not claim sent, submitted, saved, received, or successful.

formRateLimitedMessage.text: Too many inquiry attempts. Try again later, or contact us by telephone or email.
formRateLimitedMessage.editorial_note: Public 429 state. No countdown or internal rate-limit numbers.

formAttachmentUnavailableMessage.text: File upload is not available yet. Remove the file to send your message, or contact us by telephone or email.
formAttachmentUnavailableMessage.editorial_note: Public 422 state while R2 is unimplemented. File bytes are never sent.

formInvalidMessage.text: Check your details and try again, or contact us by telephone or email.
formInvalidMessage.editorial_note: Public 400 state. Does not expose Zod issues.

formInternalErrorMessage.text: The inquiry could not be sent. Please try again, or contact us by telephone or email.
formInternalErrorMessage.editorial_note: Public 500 and unexpected envelope state. No stack traces.

formTimeoutMessage.text: The request timed out. Please try again, or contact us by telephone or email.
formTimeoutMessage.editorial_note: Browser AbortController timeout. Distinct from a generic network failure.

formNetworkErrorMessage.text: A network error occurred. Please try again, or contact us by telephone or email.
formNetworkErrorMessage.editorial_note: Fetch failed without an abort. Must not claim sent or received.

formSubmittingMessage.editorial_note: Submit button label and polite live status while the request is in flight.

jinjaLocationLabel.editorial_note: Primary public operation. Full street address stays in the footer.

tanzaniaBranchLabel.editorial_note: Dodoma is a branch, not the public head office.

heading.editorial_note: Recorded thank-you H1. Not a Metalworks sentence.
